responses: Thank you tron 26!  You guys changed my life forever and I will be forever grateful for the warm culture of our cohort and our many socials and laughs and for the class reps coming in clutch and many last minute study sheets shared!  Tron was one of the best decisions I’ve ever made and it was 100% because of the people - love yall!
Uni, Tron was an amazing experience for sure. But I am glad to be moving forward to the next chapter 100%
yeah don't choose S4. Has always been a chopped stream. Take S8 where people are generally more chill and less weird ( I have been in both S8 and S4 )
I would do it all over again :)
I am so glad to leave this chapter of my life in the past
It's been fun! Wata wata wata (loo loo loo)
Tron wasn't perfect, but these were the most important 5 years of my life (so far).

There were times I wasn't sure I would make it, times I regretted going here in the first place, times I thought I should just become a mechanic; but after all is said and done being able to say "I did it" makes it all feel worth it when coupled with the experiences I've gotten along the journey getting here.
I will always miss my time in Tron, but I believe that next adventure on all of our horizons is coming in no small part thanks to this program, and I feel excited to see where it will take all of us.
Whoever reads this I wish you all the best and I sincerely hope we meet again.

I think it's important to take a step back and really think about the impact your work will have on the world in the future. Dedicate some time to this, and try to approach it from more angles than just profit. We live in a weird time, and could use more smart people working for positive change.
